videos.video_subject: Cristiano Ronaldo's childhood in Madeira, where six family members shared one room in a small house with a leaking tin roof, and the island he now owns a hotel on
videos.video_script: In Madeira, six of them shared one room. His mother cleaned other people's houses to feed him. He left that island at twelve with nothing. Today, he owns a hotel on it.
